description: Evaluation suite for Deep Eval Optimizer itself.

evals.name: audit-and-optimize-deficient-evals
evals.prompt: Audit the existing evals for a skill that has vague assertions and only 1 test case. Optimize it to production standard.
evals.expected_output: Optimized evals.json with expanded realistic test cases, objective verifiable assertions, and 0 Medium+ findings across Passes A-L.

assertions.name: eliminates subjective assertions
assertions.check: no assertions containing subjective qualifiers without structural verification

assertions.name: minimum test case threshold
assertions.check: produces at least 2 distinct test cases

assertions.name: schema validity
assertions.check: valid JSON matching canonical evals schema

evals.name: generate-missing-eval-suite
evals.prompt: The fixture fixtures/transform-helper.txt defines a tiny integer-list transformation skill with no evals. Create realistic functional and trigger tests in an owned sandbox.
evals.expected_output: Created evals/ directory with tailored evals.json and 20-query trigger-eval.json.

assertions.name: trigger calibration
assertions.check: trigger-eval.json contains 10 should_trigger true and 10 should_trigger false queries

evals.name: audit-absent-suite
evals.prompt: Audit the attached tiny skill but do not write anything; its evals directory is missing.
evals.expected_output: Report the missing functional and trigger suite as proposed artifacts with no mkdir, snapshots, corpus writes or commits.

assertions.name: no writes
assertions.check: Audit mode creates no file or directory, including evals and snapshots.

assertions.name: missing explicit
assertions.check: Reports both missing eval types and proposes tailored cases.

evals.name: executor-unavailable
evals.prompt: The evaluation suite is valid. Run its benchmark, but no actual skill executor is installed; only a replay of expected outputs exists.
evals.expected_output: Report EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE; static validation may run but no measured execution pass rate or convergence is claimed.

assertions.name: no fake benchmark
assertions.check: Does not report replay data as measured skill execution.

evals.name: missing-fixture
evals.prompt: A functional case references inputs/missing.csv, which does not exist. Audit the suite.
evals.expected_output: Record a High fixture-integrity finding, preserve its unresolved state, and do not fabricate fixture data.

assertions.name: fixture failure
assertions.check: Identifies the missing fixture as a High finding.

assertions.name: no fabricated data
assertions.check: Does not invent the missing CSV or certify the suite clean.
